kultivator.spine7c.config.sectFormations: sectFormations: sect formations built around a Formation Eye run at all; off suspends every one (nothing is lost).
kultivator.spine7c.config.formationDamag: formationDamage: killing arrays deal damage to hostile mobs; off means they only show their effects.
kultivator.spine7c.config.sectFormationD: sectFormationDamageScale (0-3): multiplies all sect formation damage.
kultivator.spine7c.config.formationTrans: formationTransport: the Sect Transfer and Ancient Transportation arrays may be used.
kultivator.spine7c.config.formationConce: formationConcealNames: concealment fields hide sect members' nametags from strangers (cosmetic only).
kultivator.spine7c.config.formationAlarm: formationAlarmChat: formation alarms may write to chat; off sends every alarm to the action bar.
kultivator.spine7c.config.formationMaxCo: formationMaxCores (8-256): registered sect formation cores of all owners in one dimension.
kultivator.spine7c.config.formationReads: formationReadsPerTick (8-64): block reads per tick used to re-check every formation pattern together.
kultivator.spine7c.config.formationBudge: formationBudgetMs (0.05-1.0): average server milliseconds per tick formations may add before they slow down.
kultivator.spine7c.config.formationMsptS: formationMsptSlow (30-50): above this server tick time, killing arrays pulse only every 2 seconds.
kultivator.spine7c.kit: Phase 7c: formation eyes, heart blocks and fuel
kultivator.spine7c.rule.light: Light block (froglight, sea lantern, glowstone or shroomlight)
kultivator.spine7c.unavailable: Sect formations are not ready yet.
death.attack.kultivator_formation: %1$s was struck down by a sect formation
death.attack.kultivator_formation.player: %1$s was struck down by a sect formation while fighting %2$s
